actions.reason: K3_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity from two complementary sources: a coherent immune/interferon-up transcriptomic program (allograft rejection NES 2.61, IFN-gamma 2.28, IFN-alpha 2.17, IL6/JAK/STAT3 2.13, fdr_q=0.001) and a BAP1-enriched mutation phenotype (OR 7.875, q_driver=0.0181) on a shared VHL/PBRM1 background. Its independence is positively supported by the K3_C0001–K3_C0003 boundary, where the current two-way assignment is strongly represented (spectral ARI 0.930, within-side affinity 0.622 vs between 0.217) and the union eigengap is dominated by the two-cluster resolution (candidate_k=2, 0.480 vs 0.448), with directionally coherent native-view separation across all four modalities (RNA 0.173, WSI 0.150, CT 0.034, WXS 0.030). The K3_C0001–K3_C0002 boundary is also directionally coherent across all four views (CT 0.121, WSI 0.085, RNA 0.057, WXS 0.017) with a represented current boundary (ARI 0.702). Internal subdivision screening shows single-cluster dominance (screen_candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.872) with only moderate-to-weak feasible k>=2 separation, so no split is supported. Candidate-specific confounder associations (tissue source site V 0.588, ct_scanner_model 0.346, ct_slice_thickness 0.076, ct_z_spacing 0.110) are noted but are unadjusted associations, not established artifacts, and do not outweigh the convergent biological and boundary evidence.

K3_C0002 has a substantively interpretable biological identity from two complementary sources: a coherent metabolic/secretion transcriptomic program (protein secretion NES 2.91, oxidative phosphorylation 2.87, fatty-acid metabolism 2.33, adipogenesis 2.11, mTORC1 2.01, fdr_q=0.001) with down-enriched allograft rejection, and a distinct mutation phenotype of significant PBRM1 (OR 0.219, q_driver=0.0143) and VHL (OR 0.271, q_driver=0.0199) depletion. Its independence is positively supported by the K3_C0001–K3_C0002 boundary, which is directionally coherent across all four native views (CT 0.121, WSI 0.085, RNA 0.057, WXS 0.017) with a represented current boundary (spectral ARI 0.702, within-side affinity 0.528 vs between 0.249). The K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundary is weak and partially conflicting (WSI negative median silhouette -0.029, majority negative fraction 0.57), but the union eigengap for that pair is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible rather than positive evidence for preserving two units; the current boundary is nonetheless moderately represented (ARI 0.698). Internal subdivision screening shows single-cluster dominance (screen_candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.705) with near-zero native-view separation for feasible k>=2, so no split is supported. Candidate-specific confounder associations are broad (tissue source site V 0.586, ct_manufacturer 0.481, ct_scanner_model 0.513, ct_slice_thickness 0.232, ct_z_spacing 0.263) but are unadjusted associations, not established artifacts, and do not outweigh the convergent biological and boundary evidence.

K3_C0003 has a coherent transcriptomic identity characterized by broad down-enrichment of immune/interferon programs (allograft rejection NES -2.10, IL6/JAK/STAT3 -2.04, IFN-alpha -1.98, IFN-gamma -1.91, complement -1.78, fdr_q=0.001) and oxidative phosphorylation (-1.88), with up-enriched UV-response-DN and Wnt/beta-catenin. Its mutation profile is directionally coherent (PBRM1/VHL-enriched, BAP1-depleted) but does not survive within-panel correction (q_driver 0.085–0.227), so WXS is weaker support than RNA. Its independence is positively supported by the K3_C0001–K3_C0003 boundary, where the current two-way assignment is strongly represented (spectral ARI 0.930, within-side affinity 0.622 vs between 0.217) and the union eigengap is dominated by the two-cluster resolution (candidate_k=2, 0.480 vs 0.448), with directionally coherent native-view separation across all four modalities (RNA 0.173, WSI 0.150, CT 0.034, WXS 0.030). Set-scope membership representation is directionally coherent across all four views (CT 0.038, RNA 0.093, WSI 0.303, WXS 0.114). The K3_C0002–K3_C0003 boundary is weak and partially conflicting (WSI negative median silhouette -0.029), but its union eigengap is single-cluster dominated (candidate_k=1), which is merge-compatible rather than positive evidence for preserving two units. Internal subdivision screening shows the largest single-cluster dominance (screen_candidate_k=1, leading gap 0.957) with low feasible k>=2 separation, so no split is supported. Candidate-specific confounder associations (tissue source site V 0.456, ct_phase 0.313, ct_manufacturer 0.262) are unadjusted associations, not established artifacts, and do not outweigh the convergent biological and boundary evidence.
